replaceHelp: Replaces the domain suffix: the old domain itself and its subdomains (including the *.old wildcard) are rewritten, so replacing old.com with new.com turns www.old.com into www.new.com. Domains that become duplicates are merged and sites without a match stay unchanged.
domainsPlaceholder: One domain per line, or separated by commas. *.example.com wildcards are supported
addHelp: Domains a site already has are skipped; new ones are appended.
removeHelp: Matches full domains; domains a site does not have are ignored. A site cannot be left without any domain.
optionsHelp: Only options set to On or Off are changed; options set to Keep stay as configured on each site. Authentication, access control, backend addresses and other settings that affect access must be edited per site.
removeConfirm: Delete the {count} selected sites ({names})? This cannot be undone.
moveHelp: Sites move with all their settings and are placed at the end, or at the end of the chosen group. Sites already in the target listener stay where they are. Nothing is moved if the target listener already has a site with the same domain. Signed-in visitors have to sign in again and statistics start over.
movePlainWarn: Some of these sites require sign-in and the target listener is plain HTTP: passwords and sign-in cookies will be sent unencrypted.
movePlainWarnOne: This site requires sign-in and the target listener is plain HTTP: passwords and sign-in cookies will be sent unencrypted.
moveNothing: The selected sites are already in the target listener
moveConfirm: Move {count} sites ({names}) to "{target}"? Signed-in visitors have to sign in again and statistics start over.
